inclusion.I1: Study uses Voxel-Based Morphometry (VBM), fMRI (resting‐state or task based), or FDG‐PET as the imaging modality
inclusion.I2: Sample- participants included clinically diagnosed behavioral variant frontotemporal dementia (bvFTD) patients

inclusion.I3: Study uses Voxel-Based Morphometry (VBM), fMRI (resting‐state or task based), or FDG‐PET as the imaging modality
inclusion.I4: Sample- participants included clinically diagnosed behavioral variant frontotemporal dementia (bvFTD) patients
inclusion.I5: Sample- At least 6 participants in either the patient or healthy group
inclusion.I6: Studies that reported at least one result of a between‐group contrast in a defined stochastic space (i.e., Montreal Neurological Institute [MNI] or Talairach)
inclusion.I7: Whole-brain evidence- The paper must report at least one group-level, whole-brain (voxelwise) result that is clearly identified as coming from the target sample group.
inclusion.I8: It is acceptable for qualifying whole-brain results to be reported in tables of coordinates, figures, or supplementary materials, as long as they are clearly described in the text.

exclusion.E3: Studies that report only region-of-interest (ROI) analyses with no whole-brain results.
exclusion.E4: Sample- with no concurrent psychiatric diagnosis (e.g., major depressive disorder and bipolar mood disorder), other forms of dementia or neurological symptoms, and no history of alcohol or substance abuse
exclusion.E5: Non-empirical papers (e.g., reviews, meta-analyses, methods-only, simulations) without original data.
exclusion.E6: only reports seed‐based functional connectivity (FC), diffusion tensor imaging (DTI), or cortical thickness methods

inclusion.GLOBAL_I1: uses Voxel-Based Morphometry, fMRI (resting‐state or task based), and FDG-PET (Fluorodeoxyglucose Positron Emission Tomography) as the imaging modality
inclusion.GLOBAL_I2: Sample- participants included clinically diagnosed behavioral variant frontotemporal dementia (bvFTD) patients with no concurrent psychiatric diagnosis (e.g., major depressive disorder and bipolar mood disorder), other forms of dementia or neurological symptoms, and no history of alcohol and substance abuse
inclusion.GLOBAL_I3: Whole-brain evidence- The analysis must be from a group-level, whole-brain (voxelwise) map

exclusion.GLOBAL_E2: Seed-based connectivity, effective connectivity (e.g., PPI, DCM), or resting-state analyses
exclusion.GLOBAL_E3: Between-group contrasts or interactions (e.g., subgroup vs subgroup, patient vs control)

inclusion.DEMENTIA_DECREASING_ACTIVITY_I1: Analyses on experiments reporting any decreases in activity/connectivity, metabolism, or gray matter volume for bvFTD group (e.g. Control > bvFTD or bvFTD < Control)

exclusion.DEMENTIA_DECREASING_ACTIVITY_E1: Analyses that show control group has decreases in activity, connectivity, metabolism, or in gray matter volume relative to bvFTD group

inclusion.STRUCTURAL_I1: Analses using Voxel-based morphometry (VBM) for imaging

inclusion.FUNCTIONAL_I1: Analyses that use one or more of the following imaging modalities- functional imaging (FDG-PET, resting-state fMRI (rs-fMRI), task-based fMRI (t-fMRI)) imaging
